purpose: Reference tables for storage parameters (c^E energy cost per kWh, c^P power cost per kW, eta round-trip efficiency, fixed O&M), derived from NREL ATB and PNNL ESGC cost databases.

nrel_atb.retrieved_via: OEDI data lake S3 (official ATB distribution host)

pnnl_esgc.retrieved_via: Wayback Machine replay of pnnl.gov (origin host TLS-blocked from this network)

conventions.atb_decomposition: capex_usd_per_kw(h) = c_power_usd_per_kw + h * c_energy_usd_per_kwh (OLS over 2-10 h)
conventions.atb_capex_basis: $/kW AC, total installed, ATB core metric CAPEX
conventions.pnnl_energy_side: sum of $/kWh items (DC storage block, BOS, systems integration, EPC, project development)
conventions.pnnl_power_side: sum of $/kW items (power equipment/PCS, grid integration, construction & commissioning)

caveats: ATB CAPEX is a modelled bottom-up cost, not a transacted price; scenario/case columns must be kept distinct.
PNNL 'Point' estimates for 100 MW plants are used; Low/High ranges are retained in the breakdown CSV.
Neither source splits grid-side network upgrade costs, which belong to c^F and are documented separately.
